population.seed_scheme: pressure-{i}, i=0..199; same indices across NE and CHI

measurement.frame_gap: horizontal field-plane distance converted to meters; each per-play series covers snap through first throw, sack, or whistle
measurement.plus_nb_rule: include NB when pass setup heavy rule applies: Run formation/Jumbo text or goal distance <=3 yards
measurement.engagement_state: observed from live Player.engaged references using temporary World method wrappers; engine files are unmodified
measurement.contact_radii: Player.physics.radius values from the frozen team roster snapshot
measurement.limitation: horizontal circles; no vertical reach, body orientation, or continuous 3D contact inference

shed_model.code_path: rush brain calls maybeShed(p) only while engaged; a free pass uses default boost=1 and passPlay=true
shed_model.observed_event: shed events emitted by World.disengage when called with a shedder; run_block_release is only instrumented for free run blocking and is not emitted by this pass path
shed_model.forced_shed_at: the scripted kind === sack setup path sets p.ai.shedAt; this free mode uses kind === pass and cannot enter that branch

contact_logic.actual_body_contact_rule: World.collide requires center distance less than the sum of Player.r radii before invoking onTouch
contact_logic.sack_draw_chain: without a QB/front-rusher onTouch contact, the free-pass sackOdds expression is not evaluated; with contact, the callback may emit sack or pressure
contact_logic.placeholder_rating_audit: not re-derived here; see research/rating-audit-2026-10-22 at c9d4e6f

counterfactual.finding: simulatePlay accepts ctx but only reads ctx.ballY; play-local ai.shedAt is set internally only by the scripted kind === sack path. No external per-player override hook exists for free kind === pass.

shed_accounting.probability_model: per-rusher/blocker hazard λ=0.1×exp((max(PMV,FMV)-PBK)/15); exposure is counted at each actual maybeShed invocation while engaged, integrated hazard is Σ(λ×DT), P(no shed)=exp(-integrated hazard)

contact_opportunity_census.threshold_definition: front rusher radius + QB radius + 0.3 m engagement reach, measured immediately before each 120 Hz collision solve
contact_opportunity_census.body_contact_threshold_definition: front rusher radius + QB radius (actual player collider overlap), measured immediately before each 120 Hz collision solve
contact_opportunity_census.interpretation: World.collide invokes onTouch only for actual collider overlap; the +0.3 m rule is an engagement-reach proxy, not the collision radius.
